decisions.reason: The agreed clarification establishes that the finalized BOM requires no further iteration or additional components at this stage.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey — I wanted to quickly clarify the scope of this milestone.

Given that the BOM has already been finalized and every part has been purchased and shipped, can you confirm that this milestone is now for the completed system layout and wiring plan, rather than another parts list to purchase from?

I also want to ensure we agree that no further components are required at this stage and that the project is proceeding into the build and integration phase.

Let me know what you think.

decisions.reason: The source's impact is already fully represented by the existing same-message MODIFY establishing a completed, milestone-local system layout.
Finalization of the BOM and transition to build do not alter the existing off-the-shelf component strategy.
The milestone deliverable clarification does not change the unit's stability or vibration-control requirements.
The source does not change the selected 120V wall-power configuration.
The source does not alter the dispensing mechanism, sequence, flow, or control behavior.
The statement that no further components are required does not change the approved load-capacity, controller, or power-supply requirements.
The milestone clarification has no effect on the requirement to isolate electrical components from liquid.
The source does not change the spout's geometry, orientation, material, or appearance.
